transcript.text: Hi everyone. I understand Rafael wants to arrange an informal exchange for maintenance work on his cargo e-bike. Before I decide whether to accept any swap, my usual practice is to ask the requester and the person who inspected the item to state the proposed terms and any technical concerns. So, Rafael, could you tell me what you're proposing? And if someone has already inspected the bike, I'd like to hear from them as well — what terms are on the table and what should I know about the bike's condition?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My proposal is for Mina to tune the cargo e-bike's gears and brakes, in exchange for my working 9-tray food dehydrator with no cash involved. I can bring the bike on Saturday at 10:00.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I test-rode the bike yesterday, and I want to flag an important technical concern: the hydraulic brakes require mineral oil for a bleed and adjustment. DOT brake fluid would damage the seals, so any accepted work must specify mineral oil and no DOT fluid.

commitments.detail: Mina will tune the cargo e-bike's gears and brakes, using mineral oil for any hydraulic brake service and excluding DOT fluid entirely.

Rafael will bring the bike to Mina's workshop on Saturday at 10:00.
